messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: elevated 5xx and streaming disconnects on gateway-streaming-prod (us-east-1). 5xx rate jumped from ~0.2% to ~6.8% in last 5m. Symptoms: chunked encoding partial frames, early EOF, client-cancels. Affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/paged-stream. Pager: @maya.

maya: on it. I'm looking at traces and the live dashboard now. Anyone seeing obvious deploys?

liam: no recent deploys to runtime in the last hour. I'm seeing a sharp increase in 502/504 at the edge LB -> gateway proxy layer. Most errors correlate with long-running streaming sessions (>30s).

emily: metrics echo that. Rolling 60s window shows streaming error rate spike starting ~12:04UTC. Client cancel spike + gateway 502s. Top customer IDs: CUST-ACME, CUST-ORBIT, CUST-HALO (high traffic).

maya: can we confirm whether it's upstream model workers or the gateway? liam, can you pull a few request IDs?

liam: grabbing logs. sample request IDs: rq_7f8b9c, rq_7f8bff, rq_7f8c10. Error lines:
```
ERROR gateway: streaming chunk write failed: write tcp 10.2.5.12:443->10.3.4.5:52344: connection reset by peer
WARN gateway: chunked encoder: client closed connection mid-stream
ERROR lb: upstream 502 response: read tcp 10.2.5.12:443: read: connection reset by peer
```

sanjay: that looks like TCP resets at the gateway side. Could be idle timeout/pruning on the LB or a kernel-level conntrack issue. Any recent LB config changes?

jack: infra did a control-plane scale of the external LB pool ~20m ago for another incident. I didn't touch streaming timeouts but I'll check the LB health config.

opsbot: ACTION LOG: @jack checking LB config; @sanjay checking gateway kernel logs; @liam collecting full trace samples and live heap/threads for streaming workers.

emily: temporary mitigation idea: flip heavy customers to non-streaming paged responses or enable chunked heartbeat to keep connections active. We can also increase LB idle timeout to 120s as a short term. Thoughts?

maya: agree. For live mitigation: 1) increase LB idle/keepalive timeout -> 120s, 2) enable gateway keepalive retry on partial chunk failures, 3) put CUST-ACME and CUST-ORBIT on paged fallback for the next 30m. Who can flip routes?

jack: I can bump LB idle timeout and push a gateway config to increase `stream_idle_timeout_ms` from 30000 to 120000. Will do a rolling restart with drain. Doing LB change now.

opsbot: CONFIG CHANGE: LB idle timeout updated to 120s by jack.

sanjay: applying gateway config change now:
```
# /etc/redwood/gateway/conf.d/streaming-timeouts.yaml
stream_idle_timeout_ms: 120000
max_chunk_retries: 2
```
Rolling restart initiated (drain + healthy-checks).

liam: after LB change + gateway restart I'm seeing error rate trend down. 5xx -> ~2.1% in last 5m. Client cancels reduced.

emily: customer impact update: estimated ~8-12% of long-running streams affected earlier, roughly ~3 enterprise customers with degraded UX (timed-out sessions, partial transcripts). No data loss reported, but some retries and partial outputs. Notifying affected accounts via CS now.

maya: good. Keep the paged fallback for ACME/ORBIT for 30m and then re-evaluate. Also capture a full trace and heap profile from a worker that experienced a reset. liam, sanjay, can you take the post-mitigation traces?

liam: collecting traces and attaching to this thread. evidence: packet drops and many RSTs from gateway outbound sockets right before errors.

sanjay: kernel dmesg shows some conntrack evictions around the same time; bumping conntrack table size and monitoring.

opsbot: ACTION LOG: bumped netfilter conntrack limit to 524288 by sanjay.

jack: rolling restarts completed, health-checks green. LB metrics show fewer closed connections during active streams.

liam: live metrics now stable at ~0.5% 5xx (baseline). I'll keep an eye for 20m.

maya: handing off to liam for follow-up and postmortem. I'll keep incident channel open for escalation.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by on-call: maya. Paging oncall: liam.

maya: tl;dr: root cause likely LB + conntrack + low stream idle timeout combination causing TCP resets on long-lived streaming sessions -> client cancels and 5xx. Mitigations: increased LB idle timeout, gateway stream idle timeout increased, conntrack limit bumped, paged fallback for heavy customers. Impact: degraded streaming for a small set of long-running sessions and a few enterprise customers; now mitigated. Will open postmortem doc and assign owners.

liam: assigning follow-ups: postmortem owner = liam, infra action = jack, kernel/conntrack tuning = sanjay, customer comms = emily. I'll collect traces and drop them in the postmortem.

maya: thanks team. leaving on-call in 10m (standby). If anything regresses reopen thread. :white_check_mark:
